description: Source code for the 'root-alias.cjs' module which provides plugin SDK utility functions, module resolution, and exports. It handles dynamic loading of SDK components, environment configuration, and provides a proxy interface for module access.

methods.name: emptyPluginConfigSchema
methods.description: Creates a schema object for validating plugin configs, ensuring they are empty objects.

methods.name: resolveCommandAuthorizedFromAuthorizers
methods.description: Determines if a command is authorized based on provided authorizer rules.

methods.name: resolveControlCommandGate
methods.description: Decides whether to block a control command based on authorization and command properties.

methods.name: onDiagnosticEvent
methods.description: Sets up a listener for diagnostic events from the diagnostic-events module.

methods.name: getPackageRoot
methods.description: Returns the root directory path of the package.

methods.name: findDistChunkByPrefix
methods.description: Finds a distribution chunk file with a specific prefix in the 'dist' directory.

methods.name: listPluginSdkExportedSubpaths
methods.description: Lists exported subpaths in the plugin SDK as specified in package.json.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkAliasMap
methods.description: Builds a map of SDK alias paths for module resolution.

methods.name: getJiti
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Jiti loader instance for dynamic module loading.

methods.name: loadMonolithicSdk
methods.description: Loads the main SDK module, preferring dist build if available.

methods.name: loadDiagnosticEventsModule
methods.description: Loads the diagnostic-events module, with fallback to source.

methods.name: normalizeDiagnosticEventsModule
methods.description: Normalizes the diagnostic events module to ensure it has the correct shape.

methods.name: tryLoadMonolithicSdk
methods.description: Attempts to load the SDK module, catching errors.

methods.name: getExportValue
methods.description: Retrieves exported property, considering monolithic SDK fallback.

methods.name: getExportDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves property descriptor, considering monolithic SDK fallback.

methods.name: shouldResolveMonolithic
methods.description: Determines if a property should resolve from monolithic SDK.

methods.name: getMonolithicSdk
methods.description: Returns the loaded monolithic SDK instance if available.
